semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in ultrapure pipeline systems critical for semiconductor wet processes.
summary: HPRAY (Changzhou) Clean System Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures ultrapure pipeline systems essential for the delivery and control of ultrapure water and electronic-grade chemicals in semiconductor fabrication. Their products are integral to various processes such as etching, coating, and cleaning in wafer fabs.
capabilities: Ultrapure pipeline systems for semiconductor wet processes
Measurement and control instruments for ultrapure systems
Manufacturing of pipes, fittings, and valves from PVDF and PFA materials

regional_presence.China: The company is located in the Changzhou High-tech Industrial Development Zone, Jiangsu Province.
